```{r}
sample_ps <- function(ps, FUN = sample, ...){
  ids <- sample_names(ps)
  sampled_ids <- FUN(ids, ...)
  ps <- prune_samples(sampled_ids, ps)
  return(ps)
}
```


```{r}
HIV_path <- "D015497_HIV-1/species/phyloseq.RData"
Kidney_path <- "D007674_Kidney_Diseases/species/phyloseq.RData"
Diabetes_path <- "D003924_Diabetes_Mellitus,_T/species/phyloseq.RData"
IBD_path <- "D003093_Colitis,_Ulcerative/species/phyloseq.RData"
```

```{r}
# Load the phyloseq objects
ps_HIV <- get(load(HIV_path))
ps_Kidney <- get(load(Kidney_path))
ps_Diabetes <- get(load(Diabetes_path))
ps_IBD <- get(load(IBD_path))
```


```{r cars}
ps_HIV_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_HIV, function(x) x / sum(x))
otu_HIV_rel <- as(otu_table(ps_HIV_rel), "matrix") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
meta_HIV_rel <- as(sample_data(ps_HIV_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()
tax_HIV_rel <- as(tax_table(ps_HIV_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()

ps_HIV_genus <- tax_glom(ps_HIV_rel, taxrank = "Species")

plot_bar(ps_HIV_genus, fill = "Species") +
  facet_nested(~ Disease.MESH.ID, scales = "free_x") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

ps_HIV_sick <- subset_samples(ps_HIV_genus, Disease.MESH.ID == "D015497")

#plot_bar(ps_HIV_sick, fill = "Species") +
#  facet_nested(~ Disease.MESH.ID, scales = "free_x") +
#  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
ps_IBD_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_IBD, function(x) x / sum(x))
otu_IBD_rel <- as(otu_table(ps_IBD_rel), "matrix") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
meta_IBD_rel <- as(sample_data(ps_IBD_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()
tax_IBD_rel <- as(tax_table(ps_IBD_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()  

ps_IBD_genus <- tax_glom(ps_IBD_rel, taxrank = "Genus")

ps_IBD_genus_sampled <- sample_ps(ps_IBD_genus, FUN = sample, size = 80)

plot_bar(ps_IBD_genus_sampled, fill = "Genus") +
  facet_nested(~ Disease.MESH.ID, scales = "free_x") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
ps_Diabetes_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_Diabetes, function(x) x / sum(x))
otu_Diabetes_rel <- as(otu_table(ps_Diabetes_rel), "matrix")
meta_Diabetes_rel <- as(sample_data(ps_Diabetes_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()
tax_Diabetes_rel <- as(tax_table(ps_Diabetes_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()

ps_Diabetes_genus <- tax_glom(ps_Diabetes_rel, taxrank = "Genus")
ps_Diabetes_genus_sampled <- sample_ps(ps_Diabetes_genus, FUN = sample, size = 80)
plot_bar(ps_Diabetes_genus_sampled, fill = "Genus") +
  facet_nested(~ Disease.MESH.ID, scales = "free_x") +
```
